tools.name: latvia_holidays
tools.description: List Latvia's public holidays in 2026 or 2027, sorted by date, each with its Latvian and English name. tools.name: latvia_leave_entitlement
tools.description: Estimate annual paid leave under the Latvian Labour Law, in calendar days excluding public holidays. Use it to answer how much leave someone has in a year; to find when to take it use latvia_plan_time_off, which counts leave in working days, a different unit. Pass annual_base=28 (the legal minimum)

tools.description: Suggest up to ten long breaks in 2026 or 2027, best first, where a few leave days bridge weekends and Latvian holidays. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "latvia_calendar_statistics" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
